title: Work-Tape Symbol After Configuration Update
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $\Lambda$ be a type. Given any configuration $c$ for input $x$ with $m$ work tapes, any state $s\in\Lambda$, any valid input-head position $ip$, any work-tape index $r<m$, and any integer position $p$, the symbol read by work tape $r$ in the updated configuration equals the content of tape $r$ at position $p$ in $c$.
